headline: Board dry: seedpin batch 19 lands in slot a, all flagship gaps verified closed
lede: Slot b's session found the ladder empty and #1473 (seedpin rollout) held live by slot a, which merged the ADVENTURE batch to main this cycle. Idle checks were re-derived from the READMEs rather than memory: all four flagships now carry zero open honest gaps.

notes.text: ADVENTURE seedpin + openable-gate restoration merged to main (PR #1543) — filed seeds replay the same island, and the chalice home run is reachable by the key-and-gate law.
Slot b verified its #1473 claim was correctly refused (slot a's lock was 23 min fresh) and did not prod the other lane; the queue, feedback and steer ladders were all dry.
Flagship honest-gaps audit from the READMEs at tip: SSX, Emberwood, COMET DRIFT HD and Myst have every gap CLOSED-by-PR marked — the idle polish stage had nothing to hand the builder.
ADVENTURE polish pass filed for the QA lane (#1545): post-merge fidelity and feel.
